paragraphs: The name of a gentile, mentioned in the time of Abaye. Eruvin 63b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: סג:. gives Eruvin 63b under the colon convention with terminal stop, without independent named-edition verification.

Both Lachman and Haman are supplied alternatives. עכו״ם, literally idolater, is Hyman’s term rendered gentile; the notice places him in Abaye’s time without fresh historical admission. No separate personal title is supplied.
